notes: Every number is a measurement on the Arc A770 with nothing else on the card (llama.cpp, -ub 512; Vulkan on the host and in the full-vulkan container, SYCL in the full-intel container — each row's measured_on names its platform); the ledger config/models.md holds the rows. This registry is read when A770B_CARD_MODE=inference; config/profiles.json is read in display mode. builder.env and the environment override any A770B_<NAME>_* value; the card reports what is served. useful_ctx is the largest depth at which decode stays above four tokens a second, taken from the 8k and far-end points by extending the time per token linearly, capped by the depth probe where one failed. Rows are compared on their task numbers only within one instrument; the card's comparable_with lists them.
